## One Tag, Endless Possibilities {background-color="#0a1628"}

<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.55em; letter-spacing:0.15em;">01 / THE BIG IDEA</p>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="48%"}
<div style="padding-top:30px;">
<p style="font-size:0.7em; color:#d0d8f0; line-height:1.6;">
A static screenshot is frozen. But with one <code style="color:#e8b84b;">&lt;iframe&gt;</code> you can drop <b style="color:#fff;">live, interactive content</b> straight into your slides or website.
</p>
<p style="font-size:0.7em; color:#d0d8f0; line-height:1.6; margin-top:14px;">
Videos, maps, dashboards, notebooks — if it lives on the web, you can embed it.
</p>
</div>
:::

::: {.column width="4%"}
:::

::: {.column width="48%"}
```html
::: {=html}
<iframe
  src="PASTE_ANY_URL_HERE"
  width="100%"
  height="500px"
  frameborder="0"
  allowfullscreen>
</iframe>
:::
```
<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.5em; margin-top:8px;">✓ Same pattern works for everything</p>
:::

::::

---

## Example 1 — YouTube Video {background-color="#0a1628"}

<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.48em; letter-spacing:0.15em; margin-bottom:8px;">
  02 / LIVE DEMO &nbsp;·&nbsp; <code style="color:#e8b84b;">youtube.com/embed/VIDEO_ID</code>
</p>

::: {=html}
<iframe
  src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/_f3latmOhew"
  style="width:100%; height:70vh; border:1px solid rgba(46,196,182,0.3); border-radius:8px;"
  frameborder="0"
  allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
  allowfullscreen>
</iframe>
:::

---

## Example 2 — Google Maps {background-color="#0a1628"}

<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.48em; letter-spacing:0.15em; margin-bottom:8px;">
  03 / LIVE DEMO &nbsp;·&nbsp; <code style="color:#e8b84b;">maps.google.com/maps?q=…&output=embed</code>
</p>

::: {=html}
<iframe
  src="https://maps.google.com/maps?q=UC+San+Diego&z=14&output=embed"
  style="width:100%; height:70vh; border:1px solid rgba(46,196,182,0.3); border-radius:8px;"
  frameborder="0"
  allowfullscreen>
</iframe>
:::

---

## Example 3 — Tableau Dashboard {background-color="#0a1628" .scrollable}

<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.48em; letter-spacing:0.15em; margin-bottom:4px;">
  04 / LIVE DEMO &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/chi.yen.lin/viz/USRailwayEducationFinalVersion/Dashboard" target="_blank" style="color:#e8b84b; text-decoration:none;">↗ View on Tableau Public</a>
</p>

::: {=html}
<iframe
  src="https://public.tableau.com/views/USRailwayEducationFinalVersion/Dashboard?:showVizHome=no"
  style="width:100%; height:80vh; border:1px solid rgba(46,196,182,0.3); border-radius:8px;"
  frameborder="0"
  allowfullscreen>
</iframe>
:::

---

## Example 4 — Live Jupyter Notebook {background-color="#0a1628" .scrollable}

<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.48em; letter-spacing:0.15em; margin-bottom:8px;">
  05 / LIVE DEMO &nbsp;·&nbsp; JupyterLite runs <b style="color:#fff;">entirely in the browser</b> — audience can edit &amp; run code live &nbsp;
  <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/" target="_blank" style="color:#e8b84b; text-decoration:none;">↗ Open in Colab</a>
</p>

::: {=html}
<iframe
  src="https://jupyter.org/try-jupyter/lab/index.html"
  style="width:100%; height:74vh; border:1px solid rgba(46,196,182,0.3); border-radius:8px; background:#fff;"
  frameborder="0"
  allowfullscreen>
</iframe>
:::

## Key Takeaways {background-color="#0a1628"}

<h2 style="font-size:1.35em; margin-bottom:0;">One tag. <em style="color:#e8b84b;">Endless</em> possibilities.</h2>

<div class="highlight-box">
  Anything that lives at a URL — a video, a map, a dashboard, a notebook — can be embedded with a single <code>&lt;iframe&gt;</code> inside a <code>::: {=html}</code> block.
</div>

<div class="check-item">✓ &nbsp; Find the content's embed URL (Share → Embed)</div>
<div class="check-item">✓ &nbsp; Drop it into an <code>&lt;iframe&gt;</code> in your <code>.qmd</code> file</div>
<div class="check-item">✓ &nbsp; Set <code>width</code> / <code>height</code>, then <code>quarto render</code></div>
<div class="check-item">✓ &nbsp; Your slides &amp; site become interactive, not static</div>
